decision.detail: BiGGen stays 1-D ('general' skill). The exploratory data-driven diagnostic below is the recorded evidence. No multi-skill Q-matrix was authored; doing so is a DEFERRED, OPTIONAL future step (not done) -- see deferred_optional_future_step.

feasibility_gate.detail: BiGGen bank/rubrics have q_mapping=null, primary_skill='general', q_modeled={'general':1} for every criterion. No named multi-skill Q-matrix exists, so the confirmatory 1..5 sweep is NOT run; a data-driven diagnostic is run instead and the sweep is STOPPED short.

capability_composites.note: SKILL_AXIS_NOTES Finding 1 recomputed on our binary atoms: high capability collinearity => general ability dominates; safety is the capability that separates most.

m2pl_1v2_probe.note: EXPLORATORY only. The 2-D probe loads a normative axis on capability=='safety' atoms (cross-loading; non-safety atoms anchor general). It uses the existing capability field, not a fabricated Q.

verdict.recommendation: Keep UNIDIMENSIONAL. A dominant general factor drives the atoms (PC1/PC2 ~ 6.3; capability composite mean|r| ~ 0.93), and the notes' strongest 2-D candidate (general + normative/safety) does NOT win out-of-sample (held-out log-loss ties/loses vs 1-D) and loses on BIC -- only AIC, which overfits at N=52, favors it (latent corr ~0.6, so the axes are not independent). Safety is the one capability that separates, echoing SKILL_AXIS_NOTES.
verdict.parallel_analysis_reconciliation: Horn parallel analysis flags 4 components above the permutation null. This is EXPECTED and LIBERAL at n_atoms >> n_models and reflects the weak residual cross-cutting structure SKILL_AXIS_NOTES Finding 3 describes (the A/B/C demand clusters under the general factor). It is NOT evidence for a confirmatory multi-skill model: that structure does not survive cross-validation here, and no named Q-matrix exists to test it.
verdict.deferred_optional_future_step: A named, labeled multi-skill Q-matrix (per-criterion q_mapping / primary_skill) does not exist for BiGGen and was NOT authored (user decision: keep 1-D). Should a future run want a confirmatory 1..5 sweep, someone would first have to author such a Q (e.g. the 'general + normative restraint' 2-D or the demand-based A/B/C 3-D axis discussed in data/BiGGen/SKILL_AXIS_NOTES.md); that is an OPTIONAL future step, not a pending blocker for this study.
